narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase structure.
finalText:
About 1286 hits in 94 files. Most are **safe internal renames**.

| zone | hits | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` JS names | ~950 | rename |
| SQL strings in `services/**` | 250 | keep, column is frozen |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | applied history, never edit |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | generated, refresh overwrites |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | public contract, breaking |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE | 2 | left key renames, value frozen |
| `lib/audit.js` | 3 | rename |

Sign off only with those four no-go zones carved out. The DB column stays `account_id`.

Next: ask the team for a per-zone diff plan.
